raw_text:
Native macOS menu bar speech-to-text app: hold hotkey, speak, release; text appears via Groq API. macOS 13.0+, Apple Silicon; Swift 5.0, SwiftUI.

`git checkout -b feature/<name>` before changes.
After Swift file changes, always run:
`xcodebuild -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -configuration Debug build`

Commands:
`xcodebuild test -project whisperswift.xcodeproj -scheme whisperswift -destination 'platform=macOS'`
`./scripts/build-with-timing.sh`
`./scripts/check-duplicates.sh`
`./scripts/generate-docs.sh`

Sandbox disabled for global hotkeys/accessibility API. Carefully edit `whisperswift/whisperswift.entitlements`. Logs: `/tmp/whisperswift.log`.

Read relevant docs first: codebase `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`; build performance `docs/BUILD_PERFORMANCE.md`; feature flags `docs/feature-flags/FEATURE_FLAGS.md`; style `docs/CODE_STYLE.md`; observability `docs/OBSERVABILITY.md`; CI/CD `docs/CI_CD.md`; release/DMG `docs/RELEASE_BUILD.md`; alerting `docs/alerting/ALERTING.md`.
